mechanismCoverage.section: 3. Базовый уровень и преимущество: сравнение с ожиданием

mechanismCoverage.section: 4. Генерация текста как эпизод обучения с подкреплением
mechanismCoverage.retained: Same-response reference probabilities, signed sampled KL terms and rewards fixed before optimizer steps.
Current, behavior/old, reference, reward and value roles; old log probabilities need not require another live model; shared critic backbone and placement tradeoffs.
Local versus trajectory ratio, six sign/ratio regions, loss clipping versus ratio clamp, no hard ratio or KL bound, and shared-parameter effects.
Actor/value/entropy signs, stop-gradient targets, KL placement and maximized log-likelihood PPO-ptx.

mechanismCoverage.section: 8. Тензоры и поток данных для одного пакета; 9. Один цикл PPO
mechanismCoverage.retained: Pre-action hidden states/logits, prompt/response alignment, right-padding guards, terminal-score scatter, token weighting and actual tiny-Transformer CPU optimizer step.

mechanismCoverage.section: 10. Основные причины неудачного обучения; 11. Что измерять
mechanismCoverage.retained: Reward exploitation, critic errors, response diversity/length, old-rollout lag versus wrong behavior log probabilities, independent quality and two distinct KL measurements.

excludedClaims: PPO clipping is a hard trust-region or a guarantee on every probability ratio/KL, or a clipped individual term freezes the entire model update.
TRPO must form and store its full Hessian; the reference implementation uses Hessian-vector products and conjugate gradients.
GAE is required by the PPO-Clip definition, a critic must have the policy's size, or four functional roles imply four equally sized models resident on one GPU.

Maximizing the displayed clipped surrogate plus positive cross-entropy is the PPO-ptx objective; the correct pretraining contribution is maximized log likelihood, or positive CE in a consistently minimized loss.
A universal 10%-of-total-loss rule or one universal set of eps/lambda/beta/epochs follows from InstructGPT.
GRPO is always more stable/better than PPO, DeepSeek-R1 establishes an equal-condition PPO comparison, or all production alignment follows a claimed historical trend.
